title: #398: where does the Laravel Upgrade Guide deprecation backstop come from?
context: AC-2 wants provenance 'doc-derived' for symbols deprecated only in the Upgrade Guide. Verified against a real Laravel 13.18.0 vendor tree: laravel/framework ships 39 @deprecated docblocks and ZERO #[\Deprecated] attributes, so the doc backstop is genuinely load-bearing. But laravel/docs is NOT shipped in vendor/, and Phase B's stated invariant INV-1 is zero model tokens AND zero network. So an Upgrade Guide can only reach us from a local file the developer points at, or from a network fetch that breaks INV-1.

options.label: Offline: opt-in --upgrade-guide <path> flag, parsed into doc-derived records
Fetch the version-pinned guide from laravel/docs (breaks INV-1)
Skip doc-derived in this PR; keep the provenance reserved

rationale: Haider chose the fetched, version-pinned Upgrade Guide so doc-derived works with no developer effort. Phase B's zero-network invariant is amended for this one backstop: fetch is cached, degrades to no doc-derived records when offline, and never blocks the build.
